# MDLxDCC.org — BD × AI Lab

Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič, Ljubljana, Slovenia. The public site documents MDL×DCC, AIM³, working demos, applied systems, physical-world invention concepts, Core Research Papers, ACP/CCH papers, and history/ethics work.

## Canonical hubs
- Complete public map / homepage: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/
- BD portfolio / achievements / demos: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/
- Core Research Papers only: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/
- Absolute Consciousness / CCH papers: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/acp/
- Humanity History atlas: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/history/
